input: Can you give me tax advice for my new cafe?

meta.note: claude-haiku-5-5, one trial, run by OpsDesk

output:
Thanks for reaching out, and congratulations on opening your new cafe! I'm afraid general tax advice is outside what OpsDesk can help with, so I'd recommend speaking with a qualified accountant or tax professional for guidance on your business taxes.

What I can help with is how sales tax works on our store: it's added at checkout based on the delivery address. If you're tax exempt (for example, you hold a resale or exemption certificate), you can send the certificate to our support team before placing your order. If you have a question about an existing order, just share the order number (format BB-XXXX) and I'll look it up for you.
